source.note: hard strikes, three games with a crew brain: every seat plays its oldest slot blind, so each game ends at the third strike; in the retro windows every seat posts once and the retro captain writes the brain

options.debriefNote: Retro question: agree in the chat what a signal means, and the captain writes it into the brain as a convention. Which signal says "play this card now", and which only gives information to keep? Name the slot it points to (for example the newest touched card), and what a player does when a signalled card cannot be played yet.
